column1: Note: All numbers are in current (nominal) US $

For a discussion of the definition of remittances, see "Workers' Remittances: An Important and Stable Source of External Development Finance", Global Development Finance 2003, World Bank. Data since 2005 are based on IMF BOP Statistics that use the definitions of IMF BPM6.
For additional information, please also see "International Transactions in Remittances: Guide for Compilers and Users", International Monetary Fund, 2009.
Some countries, such as China and Vietnam, have gaps in data following the transition from BPM5 to BPM6. Past data and some current trends are used to arrive at estimates  in such cases.
When using the data, please cite: World Bank Migration and Development Brief 2025
